about: Every typology that fits every lot: for each lot and each of the 8 typologies, the best fitting layout (most MW, then fewer storeys) or "none" with the first match rule it fails. Layouts from the rebuilt library; where it has none of a typology on a lot, the earlier library's is kept. No geometry.
